definitions.explanation: The point where two streets or edges meet.

examples.japanese: {角|かど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧。

examples.english: I'm waiting at the shop on the corner.
If you turn right at the next corner, you'll see the station.

examples.japanese: {角|かど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぶつかった→ぶつかる：02412_butsukaru⟧。

examples.english: I hit my head on the corner of the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{角|かど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気|き}をつけた→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: This box has sharp corners, so homes with small children should be careful.

notes:
{角|かど} means corner (of streets, buildings) or angle/edge.

KANJI READINGS (IMPORTANT):
- {角|かど}: corner of street/building, edge
- {角|すみ}: corner of a room (inside corner)
- {角|つの}: horn (animal)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {角|かど}を⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧: to turn the corner
- {角|かど}に{立|た}つ: to stand on the corner
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧の{角|かど}: the next corner

IDIOMS:
- {角|かど}が{立|た}つ: to cause friction/offense
- {角|かど}を{取|と}る: to round off edges; to mellow (personality)

DIRECTIONS:
- その{角|かど}を{右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がってください: Turn right at that corner
- {角|かど}の{店|みせ}: the shop on the corner
